questions.question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If G % W # K & C @ M, then M is the grand Daughter of G’s ________.
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

Given:

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 @
 &
 #
 %
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Father
 Mother
 Husband
 Sister
 
 

Given, G % W # K & C @ M

 
• G % W means G is sister of W.
 
• W # K means W is husband of K.
 
• K & C means K is mother of C.
 
• C @ M means C is father of M

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a7f7e92fd26e4e76eae39cab2ab33fa4848d671985eee44df6c6c40b1f0305.png] 

According, to the tree diagram 

M is the grand daughter of G's **__brother__**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Brother**.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

C _ _ N M _ V B N _ C V _ _ M C _ B N _
questions.solution:
Here, the pattern follows is __**CVBNM**__

Let's check the options:

 
• C **__V__ __B__** N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**C**__ __**M**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**M**__ - C V __**B**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → The pattern follows here is __**CVBNM**__.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**B**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**M**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.
 
• C __**V**__ __**B**__ N M - __**C**__ V B N __**N**__ - C V __**C**__ __**N**__ M - C __**V**__ B N __**B**__ → Doesn't follow the pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is __**VBCMBNVM**__.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

JINGLE : JONGLI :: WASTED : WESTID :: CRIMINAL : ?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The logic here follows is:

 **The vowel from each word is changed to the very next vowel, in a sequential manner** **i.e** "**A, E, I, O, U**".

 
• Where in **JINGLE** the vowels **I__** and __**E**__ are changed to their next vowel i.e __**O**__ and __**I**__ and the new word form is

 J__**I**__NGL__**E**__ → J__**O**__NGL__**I**__

__
 
• In the same way, in the word **WASTED** the vowels **A**__ and __**E**__ are changed to their next vowel i.e __**E**__ and **__I__.**

 W__**A**__ST__**E**__D** ****→ **W__**E**__ST__**I**__D

__
 
• Similarly, in the word **CRIMINAL **the vowel **I**__, __**I,**__ and __**A**__ are changed to it's next vowel i.e. __**O**__, __**O**__, and __**E**__.

 CR__**I**__M__**I**__N__**A**__L → CR__**O**__M__**O**__N__**E**__L

Hence, the correct answer is "__**CROMONEL"**__.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some movies are dramas.

No drama is a comedy.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some movies are comedies.

II. All movies can never be comedies.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some movies are dramas.

No drama is a comedy.

__**Venn Diagram:**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1650a559058fff9c1669df9edb3035ebfa25d7427956a34519e572cc1c2e761.png] **__

__**Conclusions:**__

I. Some movies are comedies.→ **False **(It is possible but not defined)

II. All movies can never be comedies.→ **True **(Some movies are dramas, and drama can not be comedy)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion II follows.**"

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 112, 59, 169

Second row - 78, 66, 142

Third row - 137, 85, ?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (First number + Second number) -2 = Third number**

__
 
• First row – 112, 59, 169 → **(112 + 59) - 2** **=** **169**
 
• Second row** **– 78, 66, 142 → **(78 + 66) - 2 = 142**
 
• Third row – 137, 85, **220**__ → **(137 + 85) - 2 = 220**

Hence, the correct answer is '__**220**__'.
